name: Nanjing Institute of Information Technology
aliases: Nanjing Research Institute of Information Technology
supervisors: A national ministry it does not name in its own notices

evidence.summary: In recruitment notices posted on the University of Science and Technology of China’s website, the institute (also called the Nanjing 841 Institute) describes itself as a cutting-edge research institution directly under a national ministry, which it does not name, working on computing, electronics and communications from its Nanjing headquarters and branches in Beijing and Shenzhen. Its staff have received its ministerial system’s highest science and technology award and an award for young staff of central state organs.
The notices say its business has expanded to the military, the People’s Armed Police, public security bodies and the courts, among other sectors.
